generalAbilities.name: Interplanar Lifesense
generalAbilities.description: While the namorrodor is on the Shadow Plane, its lifesense extends to the Material Plane as a vague sense with a 100-foot range.

generalAbilities.name: Lifesense 30 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Lifesense allows a monster to sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

defensiveAbilities.name: Material Leap
defensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The namorrodor is on the Shadow Plane

Trigger A creature the namorrodor can sense with its lifesense on the Material Plane dies

Effect The namorrodor leaps between planes, appearing on the Material Plane within 100 feet of the triggering creature. It remains on the Material Plane for 24 hours, after which it is recalled to its original location on the Shadow Plane.

defensiveAbilities.name: Whistling Bones
defensiveAbilities.description: 30 feet. Wind whistles through the namorrodor's jutting bones with an eerie tone. A creature entering or beginning its turn in the area must attempt a DC 19 Will Saving Throw save, becoming Frightened 1 on a failure (Frightened 2 on a critical failure). A creature can't reduce its frightened condition below 1 as long as it's in the aura.

offensiveAbilities.name: Bounding Sprint
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The namorrodor has nothing in its hands

Effect The namorrodor bounds forward, using four limbs for an extra burst of speed. It Strides twice and makes a single melee Strike at the end of its movement.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
